body.heading: Where in the world is San Marino?
paragraphs: San Marino is a country in Southern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of San Marino is City of San Marino.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in San Marino is Italian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of San Marino is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is San Marino?
paragraphs: San Marino covers about 61 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: San Marino, the world's oldest republic, crowns Mount Titano with three medieval towers linked by walls — the Guaita fortress has views to the Adriatic.
The capital's steep lanes lead to the Palazzo Pubblico, where guards in colourful uniforms change — and stamp collectors hunt San Marino's famous stamps.
